text:
No fire-related thermal activity was detected at this asset in the most recent period checked. NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal detections intersecting the asset boundary between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-03. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that window, so the lack of detections isn't due to missing coverage.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the property (harvest, storm, clearing or fire), or anything outside that 30-day period. The data reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12.

If you need more certainty, burned-area or optical imagery would be the next thing to check.
